profile.summary:
▪️ Theatre artist turned Software Engineer, with experience in mobile and web development. 

▪️ Proficient in Swift, Ruby, JavaScript, SQL, HTML, CSS.

▪️ Well-versed in industry tools such as Git/GitHub/Bitbucket, Xcode, VSCode.

▪️ Experience with Swift UI, Rails, React, React Native, Heroku, Cloudflare, AWS.

▪️ Highly driven and passionate about self-education, continuous learning, and personal growth.

volunteerExperiences.description: 🎩 Artists Who Code 💻 is an online community of theatre actors, opera singers, dancers, stage managers, visual artists, classical musicians, lighting and sound designers exploring the world of tech in a fun and supportive environment, with members across the US and Australia. Founded by Catherine Ricafort and Scott McCreary, two Broadway performers && software engineers (coding pun intended), Artists Who Code advocates for creative professionals with non-traditional backgrounds in the tech industry.
